verdict: consistent: 48 signs = 48 letters = 48 red letters, 15 groups = 15 words; red 48/48; homophones ر (Rm x5, Tr x2), ك (Kj x2, Ll x2), ي (Yl, Yt x2), no shape takes two letters
notes: Rows 9-12 of image 0084_0107: 13 + 12 + 12 + 11 = 48 signs, as the record. ر has two shapes (Rm, the closed loop on a stem, x5; Tr, ط with a descending upright, x2) and ك two (Kj, the upright with a right-hand half-loop, in كيف and كبحر; Ll, the final-lam shape, in اشكر and منك); the record's "ط = ر" covers Tr only: the ك of كيف and كبحر is a different, open shape (m_ta2.png). ي: Yl once (كيف), Yt twice (لي, يقذف; one sign, not two - the record's "squeezed" لي is one sign for ي after Kd for ل). ا is the ayn-like Ea in all 6.
